workarounds.symptom: ratelimit: token bucket lets bursty Gemini traffic blow the rolling 2M/min window mid-stream
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ratelimit): pace Gemini input tokens against a rolling window, not a bucket. Target files: internal/ratelimit/ratelimit.go, internal/ratelimit/ratelimit_test.go. `internal/ratelimit` paces Gemini traffic to stay under the published `generate_content_paid_tier_input_token_count` quota (2,000,000 input tokens/min). The token budget was a `rate.Limiter` with a **full-window burst** — the comment in `New` said "spend it all at once if you like, then wait." (Ref: https://github.com/dimetron/pi-go/pull/316)

workarounds.symptom: pimodels: Resolve's Info.Model cannot be fed back into New (breaks all ollama/, azure/, opencode/ names)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: pimodels: add NewFromInfo. Target files: pimodels/pimodels.go, pimodels/pimodels_test.go, pimodels/README.md. - add `pimodels.NewFromInfo` so embedders can build the provider/model pair returned by `Resolve` without reparsing the stripped `Info.Model` - preserve the explicit `ollama/` local-routing decision on public `Info` - document the inspect-then-build path and add coverage for ollama, azure, and opencode resolved names (Ref: https://github.com/dimetron/pi-go/pull/252)
